basis: Original PLATEAU roof/top deck retained. 2025March door/platform and 2024December M-rib photos are auxiliary structural types, not October interior certification. October18 station-work article supports general elevated context only. Nearby bridge floor levels interpolated for estimated island/track bed; not measured platform floor. Lower original base kept below track bed. Rib/door/track sizes and positions estimated.
rib_revision_basis: Initial same-pose view showed outer M ribs disappearing into the source roof/ceiling. Lowered the rib profile only by .35m so it reads as a continuous frame below the retained deck. Original roof, plan positions, floor, doors/glass alpha and lighting unchanged. Connection geometry/clearance remain B estimates.
housing_revision_basis: After rib-clearance correction, geometry review found gaps between fixed door housings. Sized and centred the fixed housings from the bay pitch to connect adjacent door units. Door bay positions/count, glass opacity, floor, lighting, ribs and original roof unchanged. Exact real housing details remain estimated.
platform_width_basis: Tokyo Metro official 2019-10-28 new-station release states platform widened from about6m to about12m. Adopt12m design width; keep centre/floor height, move doors/tactile to new edges and place tracks1.35m outside each edge as an estimate. Original roof/ribs/lighting/door pitch/glass unchanged. Design reference is not independent October2025 interior survey.
